data.explanation: Your housing cooperative (Genossenschaft) is replacing all windows in your building in January 2027, with your apartment scheduled for 12 January 2027 starting at 7:30 and lasting about six hours. They ask you to confirm by the deadline shown whether you can be present for that date. If you do not reply in time, they will set a replacement date for you instead without asking again. If the date does not work for you, contact them using the phone number or email on the letter before the deadline. No payment is involved in this letter.
